profile_text.body:
Make is a visual automation platform founded in 2015 and now part of Celonis. The company describes itself as the leading AI automation platform, trusted by over 400,000 organizations across 200 or more countries, and operates with a global team of more than 350 people. Its platform allows users to build, scale, and automate AI and agentic workflows through a no-code visual interface, written code, or natural language prompts, and it connects apps, data sources, and AI models across use cases including IT operations, marketing, lead management, and CRM workflows.

Make's primary product, tracked here as Make (Integromat) AI, offers more than 400 pre-built AI app integrations along with EU-hosted deployment options and GDPR workflow compliance. The platform supports the creation and management of AI agents designed to work alongside human teams, with an emphasis on visibility and control over automated processes.

The site also lists an MCP server entry under the name app.makefx/make-effects, described as a tool for generating reproducible image, video, and audio assets using leading models and user-supplied provider keys. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts for this company.
